name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a complete QAOA MaxCut solver in Q
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a complete QAOA MaxCut solver in Qiskit (depth p=1) for edges [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 5), (1, 2), (1, 4), (1, 5), (3, 5), (4, 5)], including manual cost/mixer construction, classical optimization, and sampling of the final state. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
